premise_pack.title: They Hunted the Last Stormglass Dragon Child… Until the Disgraced Keeper Chose to Protect It
premise_pack.emotional_promise: protective trust becomes belonging and restoration

concepts.core_mechanic: small vulnerable being in front, protector/power presence looming behind
concepts.composition: protagonist and vulnerable creature/child occupy the lower-center third; protector or transformed creature fills the upper/background third; eyes or energy connect them
concepts.emotion: fear turning into trust; protector intensity without sexualized coercion
concepts.palette: warm gold/cyan or warm gold/ice-blue contrast; luminous subject separation from darker background
concepts.text_direction: short concrete promise, 2–5 words maximum if text is used; do not restate a long title
concepts.mobile_test: at 160px wide, viewer must still identify the small creature/child, protagonist emotion, and protector silhouette
concepts.source_promise: protective trust becomes belonging and restoration
concepts.do_not_copy: Use reference images only for mechanics: hierarchy, contrast, emotion, and readability. Generate original characters, layout, typography, and world details.

concepts.core_mechanic: two or three people arranged so loyalty, betrayal, or protection is readable before any text
concepts.composition: vulnerable protagonist largest or most emotionally exposed; betrayer/protector positioned behind or opposite; use eyelines and distance rather than random crowd clutter
concepts.emotion: hurt, suspicion, longing, defiance, or protective resolve

concepts.core_mechanic: protector physically cradling a visibly childlike creature while hostile institutions or weapons remain secondary
concepts.composition: protector face and creature child form one intertwined focal unit; use matching cloth, hand position, or eyeline to make the creature read as child/person rather than pet or weapon; negative space carries a short paradoxical title or hostile silhouette
concepts.emotion: maternal/paternal grief, tenderness, and defiant protection
concepts.palette: warm skin/fire/rim light around the bond against cool institutional darkness; creature eyes bright enough to read at feed size
concepts.text_direction: use a paradox or relational label rather than explaining the whole plot; examples of structure only: protector + monster/child contradiction
concepts.mobile_test: at 160px wide, viewer must see protector tears/expression, creature child face/eyes, and that they are being held as family
